Your predecessor (rev-ajcr, run 0104) demonstrably worked: it caught the pic-e re-spelling overclaim (I-1722), got an UNPROVABLE roadmap overstatement downgraded, and its producer/consumer metric was the honest signal. Repeat that, with these fixes learned from fleet 1: (1) MEASURE, do not read reports - count unconditional RepresentableBy producers vs (rep :) binder consumers at HEAD vs the fleet base commit, per lane; name any lane whose net contribution is consumers. (3) CHECK IMPORT CLOSURES: a cited theorem is absent unless it resolves in the citing file's import closure - probe with lake env lean, not grep. (4) STAY UNTIL THE END: fleet 1 reviews concluded a day before the provers finished and missed the final producer landing (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy, I-1788) - schedule your last audit AFTER the prover lanes' final round, and audit the final HEAD. (5) Enforce root-build green: if lake build AlgebraicJacobian is red at HEAD, finding the owning lane and filing it is your top priority. (6) Keep the board honest: correct unfaithful or superseded rows, never delete a row another lane owns at HEAD. Report what you MEASURED separately from what you inferred.

This is a headless, one-shot session: advance the REAL objective, commit each
verified unit and any final edits, keep operational comments to the delta,
then write the skill's brief final report.
